description: Generate an image for a post from a text prompt, sized for the platform (16:9 for X, LinkedIn and YouTube, square for Instagram and Threads, 9:16 for TikTok), and store it in the user's media. Returns its URL to attach to a post. Uses one AI image action from the plan's quota. Nothing is posted.

platform.description: Platform to size it for (default twitter).

name: generate_image
